• CHEWY GRANOLA BARS: A combination of savory almonds, peanuts, succulent raisins and dried cranberries - plus whole grain oats; A must-have for an on-the-go snack

  • TRAIL MIX: Trail mix belongs in a bar; Enjoy trail-ready whole nuts, real fruit and delicious whole grain oats in a convenient granola bar

  • ON-THE-GO SNACK: Nature Valley Chewy Fruit and Nut Granola Bars help provide the energy you need for on the go; A portable snack perfect for the pantry, lunch box, and hiking trail

  • QUALITY INGREDIENTS: Made with real fruit and no artificial flavors, artificial colors, or high fructose corn syrup

  • CONTAINS: Twelve 7.4 oz boxes of Nature Valley Trail Mix Chewy Fruit and Nut Granola Bars; 6 bars per box
features:
Features of Nature Valley Trail Mix Chewy Granola Bars

Made with Real Ingredients
Contains whole grain oats, peanuts, almonds, raisins, and dried cranberries for a truly natural trail mix blend.

Chewy Texture with a Crunchy Kick
Combines the soft chewiness of granola with the satisfying crunch of nuts and seeds.

No Artificial Additives
Free from artificial colors, flavors, and high-fructose corn syrup.

Convenient Single-Serve Bars
Individually wrapped for easy storage, transport, and portion control.

Whole Grain Goodness
Each bar provides a good source of whole grains to support a healthy, balanced diet.

Chocolate Chunk Option Available
Blends indulgent chocolate chunks into the mix without compromising on nutritional value.

Benefits

Fuel for Active Lifestyles
Great for hiking, travel, school, office breaks, or post-workout snacking—keeps energy up without the sugar crash.

Wholesome and Nutritious
Offers a well-rounded combination of fiber, healthy fats, and complex carbs from oats, nuts, and fruits.

Family-Friendly Snack
Kid-approved and adult-loved; perfect for lunchboxes, road trips, or afternoon cravings.

Easy to Carry, Ready to Eat
No prep required—just grab and go.

Guilt-Free Satisfaction
A healthier alternative to overly processed snack bars, with ingredients you can recognize and trust.

Versatile Use
Enjoy as-is or crumble over yogurt, smoothie bowls, or oatmeal for added crunch and flavor.
ingredients: Whole Grain Oats, Corn Syrup, Almonds, Raisins, Sugar, Roasted Peanuts, Rice Flour, Vegetable Glycerin, Cranberries, Canola Oil, Fructose, Corn Starch, Soy Lecithin, Salt, Barley Malt Extract, Baking Soda, Natural Flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) Added to Retain Freshness.
